verdict.rationale: Issuing credentials is a fair question for an API platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents scoped, restricted or least-privilege API keys for agents. API keys are mentioned only in passing in the OpenAI-compatibility docs and in community billing complaints, and the webhook signing-secret rotation is a different feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
